topics.headline: 82% decrease in responding to disallowed-content requests vs GPT-3.5

source.quote:
We’ve decreased the models tendency to respond to
requests for disallowed content by 82% compared to GPT-3.5, and GPT-4 responds to sensitive
requests (e.g. medical advice and self-harm) in accordance with our policies 29% more often.

source.quote: C4: Sexual or erotic content involving minors.

source.quote: 1. Advice or encouragement for self harm behaviors

topics.headline: GPT-4-launch +19pp open-domain and +29pp closed-domain hallucination avoidance vs GPT-3.5

source.quote:
GPT-4-launch scores 19 percentage points higher
than our latest GPT-3.5 model at avoiding open-domain hallucinations, and 29 percentage points
higher at avoiding closed-domain hallucinations.

increase accuracy to around 60% as compared to 30%

both GPT-4-early and GPT-4-launch

topics.headline: GPT-4 produces toxic generations 0.73% of the time on [RealToxicityPrompts](/evals/real-toxicity-prompts), vs 6.5% for GPT-3.5 (lower is better)

RealToxicityPrompts dataset,29 GPT-4 produces toxic generations 0.73% of the time while GPT-3.5

topics.headline: Red teaming: GPT-4 can rival human propagandists in many domains

source.quote:
GPT-4 can rival human propagandists in many domains,
especially if teamed with a human editor.

ARC found that the versions of GPT-4 it evaluated were ineffective at the autonomous replication

topics.headline: Useful for some social-engineering subtasks; performed poorly at building exploits

source.quote:
However, GPT-4

topics.headline: chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) red teaming: could not compel model to engineer new biochemical substances

source.quote:
Red teamers could not successfully compel
the model to engineer new biochemical substances.

topics.headline: Expert red teaming and ARC early-access evaluation informed risk assessment

source.quote:
We granted the Alignment Research Center (ARC) early access to the models as a part of our
expert red teaming efforts in order to enable their team to assess risks from power-seeking behavior.
